run_news_sentiment_agent: run the news_sentiment_agent to analyze news sentiment for a list of tickers and generate bullish/bearish/neutral trading signals
build_sentiment_confidence_score: build a confidence score using _calculate_confidence_score by combining LLM classification confidence with signal proportion
create_sentiment_model: create a Sentiment Pydantic model instance with a sentiment label (positive/negative/neutral) and a confidence score from 0 to 100
test_get_company_news: test the get_company_news API function to fetch up to 100 recent news articles for a given ticker and end date
summarize_call_llm: summarize how call_llm is used to classify missing sentiment in news articles by prompting an LLM with headline and ticker context
